indications.trial_design: Global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 48 PV patients evaluating divesiran 6 mg Q6W vs Q12W vs placebo for 36 weeks, with 3-year double-blind/open-label extension. Primary endpoint: proportion achieving HCT < 45% without phlebotomies between weeks 18-36.
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; fully enrolled. Topline results anticipated Q3 2026.
key_milestones: FDA Fast Track and orphan drug designations; EC orphan drug
